claim: Nested Stage 4 evaluation on fixed upstream OOF inputs (random split, training rows).

inner.construction: shared.stage3.data.FoldPlan.build on each outer training partition

design.optimism: loss: outer achieved minus inner selected (positive = inner optimistic); f2: inner minus outer; aggregated with outer row weights

outer.source: accepted shared Stage 2/3 producer folds (policy nesting)

rules.historical: class decision as PR 39 (vote / F2 grid); cut by shared.stage4.protocol.tune_min_confidence on pooled inner predictions
rules.registered: class thresholds 0.10, 0.20, 1/3, 0.50 (probability outputs); cut by stage4_policy.operating_cut on pooled inner predictions

limitations: Nested Stage 4 only: upstream OOF inputs are fixed. Stage 2/3 inputs of outer-training rows come from producers fitted with outer-evaluation labels; Stage 1 (ten folds) producers of evaluation rows saw other evaluation rows. Upstream nested selection is PR 44.
Inner-to-outer differences mix selection bias with sampling variation and fit size: inner models use two thirds of the outer training partition, the outer model all of it.

Meta-XGBoost selects its proposal, class threshold and deferral cut on the same pooled inner predictions; the inner loss is optimistic for all three and outer evaluation measures the total without attributing it. The formula's inner optimism comes from its deferral cut and from pooling three inner fits with their own cuts and weights.

Historical-rule references select on pooled inner predictions with one class threshold; PR 39 selected the GLASS cut on its fitting rows and the Meta cut with fold-nested thresholds. Frozen PR 39 operating points (Step 2A replay) are a different evaluation condition.

Meta-XGBoost uses raw balanced-weight probabilities (accepted operating space); they are not calibrated. Log-loss ranking and isotonic space are Step 4B; every proposal's inner predictions are stored for that reuse. Balanced weights come from each fit's own rows.
Random-split, training-only evidence: target-derived features can use later contacts' labels and MLP early stopping shared encoder fitting (PR 42). Forward-in-time claims need PR 49.

meta_search.budget: 12 unique or 24 attempts; same proposals in every partition (procedures.*.meta_xgb.candidates)
meta_search.objective: mean inner-fold F2 at 0.5 (historical); inner log-loss recorded for Step 4B, not used

predictions.layout: rows in Step 2A table order; <upstream>.<procedure>.outer.<score> (row,), one per procedure for every rule; <upstream>.<procedure>.inner.<score> (candidate, outer fold, row), NaN outside the outer training partition; inner_fold -1 on outer rows
predictions.step_4b: Both Meta objectives rank the stored inner predictions of every proposal (no refit). A log-loss winner that differs from the F2 winner is refitted once per outer training partition. Calibrated-space inner predictions need three seed-43 subfold fits per inner fold per distinct winner; outer isotonic maps fit on the stored inner predictions.
predictions.storage: numpy savez_compressed beside this record, git-ignored
